title: Amazing football juggler – level 2
paragraphs: A man set a new record. He is from Moscow and he gave a difficult performance. He is a man who can multitask.
He stood on a giant ball while he juggled three footballs and did “keepy uppies”. “Keepy uppies” is when you flick a ball from foot to foot. The man did 36 of them in 14 seconds.
The man’s mother enrolled him into circus school when he was a child. He has been performing professionally since the age of 15.
You can read the original story and watch the video in the Level 3 section.

words.d: to do more things at once
